name: Kiq
look: a tall kickboxer of rounded quilted grey-blue segments with big shoulder pads, a black tunic and white belt, arms raised in a guard and an X-shaped mask across its small round head
entry: The kickboxer of the trinity it forms with Sawk and Throh. It keeps its guard up at all times and fights only with its legs; one of its kicks can snap a tree trunk clean through.
how: Evolve Chawp at level 20 when its Attack and Defence are equal.
Wild: rare in hills and mountains, uncommon around dojos.
Gi form (Fighting/Ice): use a Master's Gi on it.
